atJenkins.config.builds.pageSize: Number of builds to load each time the Jobs tree expands a job or loads more history.
atJenkins.config.log.pollIntervalMs: How often (milliseconds) to refresh a running build log in the editor and when following in the Output channel.
atJenkins.config.log.uiTailBytes: Maximum trailing bytes shown in the build-log editor (default 2 MiB).
atJenkins.config.follow.pollIntervalMs: How often (milliseconds) to poll Jenkins after triggering a build until it leaves the queue and finishes.
atJenkins.config.follow.maxPolls: Maximum status-bar follow polls after triggering a build.
